ai.choice-hint: How it works: below, use “Create provider” to add a provider with your key, for example Google Gemini (free, step-by-step guide right below). For text and recipes Kochheft uses the top provider of the list; photos and screenshots are read by the top one that reads images; change the order with the arrows. Audio and video: An audio provider only worked with providers that offer OpenAI's speech-to-text interface (in practice only OpenAI/ChatGPT) and only served the video download Kochheft does not do. Your own recordings are transcribed by the Whisper add-on instead; it runs locally and needs no key.
ai.order-hint: The AI asks the providers from top to bottom. If one fails, it takes the next.
ai.profile-lokal: Profile "lokal": everything stays in the house. Use only local AI providers (e.g. Ollama), no cloud keys.

free-keys.title: Free keys
free-keys.hint: One provider is enough, ideally one that reads photos. More are a reserve: when one runs out of quota, Kochheft takes the next. Free tiers change often; the test button shows whether a model fits. You enter the keys yourself.

guide.title: Step by step: set up Gemini (free)
guide.key: Get a key: open the page below, sign in with your Google account, tap "Create API key" and copy the key. Do not add a billing account there; then it costs nothing.
guide.preset: Back in Kochheft, tap here. The window opens already filled in; you only paste the key into the "API Key" field. Best leave the tick "Also add Gemini Reserve" on: when the first model's daily quota runs out, Kochheft takes the second one automatically.
guide.test: Tap "Create". Kochheft then tests the new providers itself; after a few seconds the list shows whether they work and read photos. If it shows an error, the key is usually wrong: tap the pencil icon next to the provider, paste the key again and tap "Update".
guide.mistakes: Common mistakes: when pasting the key, no space may come before or after it. The Model field takes the ID such as "gemini-3.5-flash-lite", not the name "Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite" from Google; the preset fills it in correctly.
guide.also-reserve: Also add {name} (same key, its own daily quota)
